extra_vocab.en: a strong feeling of dislike for something bad or dirty
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在客訴、餐廳衛生和顧客反應的情境，常用 in disgust 或 be disgusted at／with。語氣很強，比 dislike 強烈得多。

example.en: Poor service always disgusts customers who pay full price.
example.zh: 糟糕的服務總是讓付全額的顧客反感。

example.en: The smell of the kitchen disgusted the health inspector.
example.zh: 廚房的味道讓衛生稽查員感到厭惡。

example.en: Several guests felt disgusted by the dirty tables in the restaurant.
example.zh: 有幾位客人對餐廳髒亂的桌子感到厭惡。

example.en: The old smell is disgusting everyone who walks into the office.
example.zh: 那股舊味道讓每個走進辦公室的人都很反感。

example.en: The manager called the condition of the kitchen disgusting.
example.zh: 經理說廚房的狀況令人作嘔。

example.en: She put down the report in disgust and called the supplier.
example.zh: 她厭惡地放下報告，打電話給供應商。

example.en: Customers did not hesitate to express disgust at the long wait.
example.zh: 顧客毫不猶豫地對漫長的等待表達不滿。

example.en: The buyers were disgusted with the quality of the goods.
example.zh: 買家對這批貨的品質感到厭惡。

examples.en: The customer wrote a letter expressing her disgust at the dirty room.
examples.zh: 那位顧客寫信表達她對髒亂房間的厭惡。

examples.en: The repeated delays disgust many of our regular customers.
examples.zh: 一再的延誤讓我們許多老顧客反感。

examples.en: He left the meeting in disgust after hearing the unfair decision.
examples.zh: 聽到不公平的決定後，他厭惡地離開了會議。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音有點像，但 discuss 是「討論」，不是「厭惡」。
confusable.usage: discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不加 about：discuss the plan。

example.en: We will discuss the customer complaints at tomorrow's meeting.
example.zh: 我們明天的會議會討論顧客的客訴。

similar.diff: dislike 只是不喜歡，語氣較溫和；disgust 是強烈的反感。

example.en: Many customers dislike the new online payment system.
example.zh: 許多顧客不喜歡新的線上付款系統。

example.en: Loud phone calls annoy the people working near the window.
example.zh: 大聲講電話會惹惱靠窗工作的人。

example.en: The client was upset about the late delivery.
example.zh: 客戶對延遲交貨感到不開心。

example.en: Please be careful not to offend any of our guests.
example.zh: 請小心不要冒犯任何一位客人。

example.en: He showed his disgust when he saw the dirty kitchen.
example.zh: 他看到骯髒的廚房時，表現出厭惡。

example.en: Poor hygiene disgusts customers and hurts our business.
example.zh: 不良的衛生讓顧客反感，也傷害我們的生意。

extra_vocab.en: to throw away something you do not need or want any more
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室和製造情境：丟掉舊文件、包裝或不良品。語氣中性，比 throw away 稍微正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: discard 是及物動詞，直接接受詞：discard the box，不要寫成 discard away。

example.en: She discards unused forms at the end of every week.
example.zh: 她每週末都會丟掉沒用過的表格。

example.en: The team discarded the old plan and started a new one.
example.zh: 團隊捨棄了舊計畫，開始了新的計畫。

example.en: Discarding old files will free up space on the server.
example.zh: 刪掉舊檔案會釋出伺服器的空間。

example.en: Please discard old files that are no longer needed.
example.zh: 請丟掉不再需要的舊檔案。

example.en: Batteries must be safely discarded at the recycling point.
example.zh: 電池必須安全地丟在回收點。

example.en: The board discarded the idea because it cost too much.
example.zh: 董事會因為成本太高而捨棄了這個想法。

examples.en: Please discard any old documents before the office move.
examples.zh: 辦公室搬遷前，請丟掉所有舊文件。

examples.en: Workers must discard products that do not pass the quality check.
examples.zh: 工人必須丟棄沒有通過品質檢查的產品。

examples.en: If you receive this message by mistake, please discard it.
examples.zh: 如果你誤收到這封郵件，請直接刪除。

examples.en: We should not discard the packaging until the goods are checked.
examples.zh: 在貨品檢查完之前，我們不應該丟掉包裝。

confusable.diff: discord 是名詞「不和」，重音在前 /ˈdɪskɔːrd/；discard 是動詞「丟棄」，重音在後。

example.en: Discord between the two managers slowed down the whole project.
example.zh: 兩位經理之間的不和拖慢了整個專案。

similar.diff: 語氣比較口語；discard 較正式，常用在公文或說明中。

example.en: Please throw away the broken chairs in the storage room.
example.zh: 請把儲藏室裡壞掉的椅子丟掉。

similar.diff: 更正式，常指依規定處理大量或有害的東西。

example.en: The factory must dispose of chemical waste very carefully.
example.zh: 工廠必須非常小心地處理化學廢料。

example.en: The plant reduced its waste by twenty percent this year.
example.zh: 這間工廠今年把廢棄物減少了百分之二十。

example.en: Please put your trash in the bin before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請把垃圾丟進垃圾桶。

example.en: Our office tries to recycle paper and plastic bottles.
example.zh: 我們辦公室努力回收紙張和塑膠瓶。

extra_vocab.en: to find out what is wrong with a person or a machine
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於科技維修和醫療情境：找出機器或系統的故障原因，或醫生診斷病症。常見句型是 diagnose + 問題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: diagnose 的受詞是問題或病症（diagnose the problem）；說人得病要用被動：be diagnosed with + 病名。

example.en: This tool diagnoses most engine problems within five minutes.
example.zh: 這個工具能在五分鐘內診斷出大多數引擎問題。

example.en: The mechanic diagnosed the fault and fixed it by noon.
example.zh: 技師找出故障原因，並在中午前修好了。

example.en: Diagnosing the cause of the delay is our first step.
example.zh: 找出延誤的原因是我們的第一步。

example.en: We need an expert to diagnose a problem like this.
example.zh: 我們需要專家來診斷這樣的問題。

example.en: It is hard to diagnose the cause of the system failure.
example.zh: 要找出系統故障的原因很困難。

example.en: Two employees were diagnosed with the flu last week.
example.zh: 上週有兩位員工被診斷出得了流感。

examples.en: The technician will diagnose the problem with our printer today.
examples.zh: 技師今天會診斷我們印表機的問題。

examples.en: It took the IT team an hour to diagnose the network error.
examples.zh: 資訊團隊花了一個小時才找出網路錯誤的原因。

examples.en: Doctors can usually diagnose this illness with a simple blood test.
examples.zh: 醫生通常可以用簡單的驗血診斷出這種疾病。

examples.en: Engineers use this software to diagnose faults in the machines.
examples.zh: 工程師用這套軟體診斷機器的故障。

similar.diff: identify 只是指認出是什麼；diagnose 強調分析後找出病因或故障原因。

example.en: The team identified the cause of the delay quickly.
example.zh: 團隊很快就找出了延誤的原因。

similar.diff: 比較口語，可用在任何問題；diagnose 較專業，多用在機器和病症。

example.en: Can you figure out why the system keeps shutting down?
example.zh: 你能查出系統為什麼一直當機嗎？

example.en: An officer will inspect the factory next Tuesday.
example.zh: 下週二會有一位官員來檢查工廠。

example.en: The company will repair the machine free of charge.
example.zh: 公司會免費修理這台機器。

example.en: Please examine each product before you pack it.
example.zh: 包裝每項產品之前，請先仔細檢查。

derived.link: diagnose 去掉 e 加 -sis，變成名詞「診斷」；複數是 diagnoses
diagnos- + -tic，變成形容詞，常見 diagnostic test（診斷測試）

senses.zh: 找出（故障或問題）的原因
senses.en: to find the reason why a machine or system does not work
senses.distinguish: 受詞是機器、系統或問題時，就是找原因。

example.en: The engineer diagnosed the fault in the cooling system.
example.zh: 工程師找出了冷卻系統的故障原因。

senses.en: to say what illness a person has
senses.distinguish: 出現醫生、病人、病名時，就是醫療診斷。

example.en: The clinic can diagnose most common illnesses on the same day.
example.zh: 診所當天就能診斷出大多數常見的疾病。

extra_vocab.en: to take something away from the thing it is joined to
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於表格、設備和電子產品說明：detach the form along the line、detach the cable。語氣中性，像說明書用語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: detach 是及物動詞，常搭配 from 說明從哪裡拆下：detach A from B。也可當形容詞 detached，表示冷靜、不帶感情的。

example.en: This button detaches the screen from the keyboard.
example.zh: 這個按鈕可以把螢幕從鍵盤上拆下來。

example.en: She detached the label and put it on the box.
example.zh: 她撕下標籤，貼在箱子上。

example.en: The detached part should be stored in a dry place.
example.zh: 拆下來的零件應存放在乾燥的地方。

example.en: Detaching the battery takes only a few seconds.
example.zh: 拆下電池只需要幾秒鐘。

collocations.zh: 把 A 從 B 拆下

example.en: Detach the printer from the computer before cleaning it.
example.zh: 清潔印表機之前，請先把它從電腦上拆開。

example.en: Detach the form along the dotted line and return it.
example.zh: 請沿著虛線撕下表格並交回。

example.en: The strap is easy to detach and wash.
example.zh: 這條背帶很容易拆下來清洗。

examples.en: Please detach the bottom part of the form and keep it.
examples.zh: 請撕下表格下方的部分並自行保管。

examples.en: Detach the cable before you move the machine.
examples.zh: 搬動機器之前，請先拆下電線。

examples.en: You can detach the cover to clean the filter.
examples.zh: 你可以拆下外蓋來清潔濾網。

examples.en: Detach the receipt and send it to the finance office.
examples.zh: 請撕下收據，送到財務部。

confusable.diff: 意思相反：attach 是「附上、裝上」，detach 是「拆下」。

example.en: Please attach the invoice to your email before sending it.
example.zh: 寄出之前，請把發票附在你的電子郵件裡。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 detain 是「耽擱、扣留」，不是拆下。

example.en: A long meeting detained the manager, so he arrived late.
example.zh: 一場很長的會議耽擱了經理，所以他遲到了。

similar.diff: 範圍較廣，不一定是原本接在一起的東西；detach 強調從連接處拆下。

example.en: Please remove the old filter from the machine.
example.zh: 請把舊的濾網從機器上取出。

similar.diff: 強調把合在一起的東西分開成兩部分。

example.en: Separate the two pages before you copy them.
example.zh: 影印之前，請先把這兩張紙分開。

example.en: I attached the new schedule to this email for you.
example.zh: 我把時間表附在這封電子郵件裡了。

example.en: Please remove your bags from the meeting room.
example.zh: 請把你的袋子從會議室拿走。

example.en: Please separate paper waste from plastic waste before you leave.
example.zh: 請把紙類廢棄物和塑膠廢棄物分開。

extra_vocab.en: a computer that stays on a desk, or the main screen of a computer
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室設備、電腦採購和資訊科技情境，常說 desktop computer；也指電腦螢幕上的桌面，如 save the file to the desktop。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: desktop 當形容詞時放在名詞前面，本身不加 s：desktop computers，不寫成 desktops computers。

example.en: The company replaced all old desktops in the main office.
example.zh: 公司更換了總辦公室所有的舊桌機。

example.en: The store sells both desktop computers and tablets.
example.zh: 這間店同時販售桌上型電腦和平板電腦。

example.en: Click the desktop icon to open the program.
example.zh: 點選桌面圖示來開啟程式。

example.en: Keep important files on the desktop for quick access.
example.zh: 把重要檔案放在桌面上，方便快速取用。

examples.en: We ordered ten new desktop computers for the sales office.
examples.zh: 我們為業務辦公室訂了十台新的桌上型電腦。

examples.en: Please save the file to your desktop so I can find it.
examples.zh: 請把檔案存到你的桌面，這樣我才找得到。

examples.en: A shortcut icon will appear on your desktop after the update.
examples.zh: 更新後，你的桌面上會出現一個捷徑圖示。

examples.en: Each employee has a desktop and a company phone.
examples.zh: 每位員工都有一台桌機和一支公司手機。

confusable.diff: laptop 是可攜帶的筆記型電腦；desktop 固定放在桌上，不方便搬動。

example.en: I carry my laptop to every client meeting.
example.zh: 我每次和客戶開會都帶著我的筆電。

similar.diff: workstation 指一個工作位置，或高效能的工作用電腦；desktop 只是桌上型電腦本身。

example.en: Each workstation has a desktop and two large screens.
example.zh: 每個工作站都有一台桌機和兩個大螢幕。

example.en: The new monitor is bigger than the old one.
example.zh: 新的螢幕比舊的大。

example.en: Please clean your keyboard and monitor once a month.
example.zh: 請每個月清潔一次你的鍵盤。

example.en: Our sales staff show products on a tablet.
example.zh: 我們的業務人員用平板電腦展示產品。

example.en: The report is saved on my desktop at the office.
example.zh: 這份報告存在我辦公室電腦的桌面上。

example.en: This desktop version works better than the mobile app.
example.zh: 這個電腦版比手機應用程式好用。

senses.en: a computer made to stay on a desk

example.en: The accounting team needs a faster desktop for large files.
example.zh: 會計團隊需要速度更快的桌機來處理大型檔案。

senses.en: the main screen you see after you turn on a computer
senses.distinguish: 出現 save、icon、shortcut 等字時，指的是螢幕桌面。

example.en: Drag the folder to your desktop and open it later.
example.zh: 把資料夾拖到你的桌面，之後再打開。

extra_vocab.en: to make someone feel unhappy because something is not good enough
extra_vocab.note: 多益中較常看到 dissatisfied 和 dissatisfaction，動詞原形比較少見。常出現在顧客意見、服務品質和問卷調查的情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: dissatisfy 本身少用，實際上多用被動或形容詞：be dissatisfied with + 事物（不接 about）。

example.en: A rude reply from the staff dissatisfies most customers.
example.zh: 員工無禮的回覆會讓大多數顧客不滿意。

example.en: The new policy dissatisfied many employees at the head office.
example.zh: 新政策讓總公司許多員工不滿意。

example.en: Dissatisfied customers can return the product within thirty days.
example.zh: 不滿意的顧客可以在三十天內退貨。

example.en: Constant delays are dissatisfying our best clients every month.
example.zh: 不斷的延誤每個月都讓我們最好的客戶不滿意。

example.en: Many users are dissatisfied with the new payment system.
example.zh: 許多使用者對新的付款系統不滿意。

example.en: We always call a dissatisfied customer within one hour.
example.zh: 對於不滿意的顧客，我們一律在一小時內回電。

examples.en: Slow delivery can dissatisfy even our most loyal customers.
examples.zh: 送貨太慢，連我們最忠實的顧客也會不滿意。

examples.en: The survey shows that long waiting times dissatisfy many users.
examples.zh: 調查顯示，等待時間太長讓許多使用者不滿意。

examples.en: Late replies dissatisfy clients, so please answer within a day.
examples.zh: 太晚回覆會讓客戶不滿意，所以請在一天內回信。

confusable.diff: dissatisfied 是對結果感到不滿；unsatisfied 常指需求或要求沒有被滿足。

example.en: Unsatisfied demand for the new phone pushed prices higher.
example.zh: 新手機的需求未被滿足，推高了價格。

similar.diff: disappoint 是結果不如期待而失望；dissatisfy 是覺得不夠好、不滿意。

example.en: The poor results disappointed the whole sales team.
example.zh: 不好的成績讓整個業務團隊失望。

similar.diff: displease 較書面，是惹人不高興；語氣比 dissatisfy 更重個人感受。

example.en: Late delivery may displease our clients in Japan.
example.zh: 延遲交貨可能會讓我們日本的客戶不高興。

example.en: Several guests complained about the noise at night.
example.zh: 有幾位客人抱怨夜間的噪音。

example.en: The client was upset about the late delivery.
example.zh: 客戶對延遲交貨感到不開心。

example.en: Customers can ask for a refund within seven days.
example.zh: 顧客可以在七天內要求退款。

derived.link: 詞幹 satisfy，dis- 表示「不」，加在前面就變成「使不滿意」
satisfy 去掉 y 加 -faction，變成名詞，像 customer satisfaction
satisfact- + -ory，變成形容詞「令人滿意的」
dis- + satisfaction，「不」＋「滿意」，變成名詞「不滿」

extra_vocab.en: the act of getting rid of something, or the right to use something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於垃圾與設備處理（waste disposal），也常見固定用語 at your disposal，表示「供你使用」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「處理掉」的動詞要說 dispose of（一定要加 of）；at your disposal 的 disposal 不加 a，前面用所有格（your、his、our）。

example.en: The company reported two disposals of old equipment this year.
example.zh: 公司報告今年處理了兩批舊設備。

example.en: The city has a new waste disposal plan this year.
example.zh: 市政府今年有一個新的廢棄物處理計畫。

example.en: The disposal of old computers must follow company rules.
example.zh: 舊電腦的處理必須遵守公司規定。

example.en: A company car will be at your disposal during the trip.
example.zh: 出差期間會有一輛公司車供你使用。

examples.en: The company pays a fee for the disposal of chemical waste.
examples.zh: 公司為處理化學廢料付了一筆費用。

examples.en: The disposal of old equipment will be discussed on Monday.
examples.zh: 舊設備的處理將在週一討論。

examples.en: Our staff and meeting rooms are at your disposal.
examples.zh: 我們的員工和會議室都可供您使用。

examples.en: Proper disposal of used batteries is required by law.
examples.zh: 法律規定必須妥善處理用過的電池。

confusable.diff: disposable 是形容詞「用完即丟的」，disposal 是名詞「處理」。

example.en: The hospital uses disposable gloves to keep everything clean.
example.zh: 醫院使用拋棄式手套來保持一切乾淨。

confusable.diff: 發音和字尾很像，但 proposal 是「提案」，意思完全不同。

example.en: We will review your proposal at the next meeting.
example.zh: 我們會在下次會議審查你的提案。

similar.diff: removal 只是把東西移走；disposal 強調把東西處理掉、丟棄。

example.en: The removal of old desks took only two hours.
example.zh: 搬走舊桌子只花了兩個小時。

example.en: The plant reduced its waste by twenty percent this year.
example.zh: 這間工廠今年把廢棄物減少了百分之二十。

example.en: Garbage is collected from the office every morning.
example.zh: 垃圾每天早上都會從辦公室收走。

example.en: Our recycling program saves the company money every year.
example.zh: 我們的回收計畫每年都替公司省錢。

derived.zh: 處置（常用 dispose of：處理掉）
derived.link: 詞幹 dispose；加 -al 就變成名詞 disposal，像 arrive → arrival

derived.zh: 用完即丟的、可自由支配的

senses.en: the act of throwing away or getting rid of something

example.en: Safe disposal of old paint is important for our workers.
example.zh: 安全處理舊油漆對我們的工人很重要。

senses.en: the right or chance to use something as you wish
senses.distinguish: 固定出現在 at one's disposal，不是在說丟東西。

example.en: I will put all the sales data at your disposal.
example.zh: 我會把所有銷售資料提供給你使用。

extra_vocab.en: a place where ships stop, or a platform where trucks load goods
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於貨運倉儲和港口情境：loading dock 是裝卸貨月台。動詞可以指船靠岸，也可以指扣薪水。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: dock 當「扣薪」時，受詞是薪水或金額：dock someone's pay；不要說 dock someone（沒有這種用法）。

example.en: The port has six docks for large cargo ships.
example.zh: 這個港口有六個碼頭可供大型貨輪使用。

example.en: Our cargo ship docks at Kaohsiung every Friday morning.
example.zh: 我們的貨輪每週五早上在高雄靠岸。

example.en: The ship docked two hours later than planned.
example.zh: 這艘船比預定時間晚了兩小時靠岸。

example.en: The company docked his pay for missing the training day.
example.zh: 公司因為他缺席訓練日而扣了他的薪水。

example.en: The ship is docking at the north port now.
example.zh: 那艘船現在正在北邊的港口靠岸。

example.en: Please park your truck at the loading dock before noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把你的卡車停在裝卸貨月台。

example.en: Dock workers start their shift at six in the morning.
example.zh: 碼頭工人早上六點開始上班。

example.en: The manager decided not to dock anyone's pay for the delay.
example.zh: 經理決定不因這次延誤而扣任何人的薪水。

example.en: Connect the laptop to the docking station on your desk.
example.zh: 請把筆電接到你桌上的擴充底座。

examples.en: The ship will dock at the port early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 那艘船明天一大早會在港口靠岸。

examples.en: Trucks must wait at the loading dock until the gate opens.
examples.zh: 卡車必須在裝卸貨月台等到閘門打開。

examples.en: The company may dock your pay if you are late.
examples.zh: 如果你遲到，公司可能會扣你的薪水。

examples.en: Workers at the dock are unloading boxes from the cargo ship.
examples.zh: 碼頭的工人正在從貨輪上卸下箱子。

confusable.diff: deck 是船的甲板（/dek/）；dock 是船停靠的碼頭，兩者位置不同。

example.en: Passengers can enjoy the view from the top deck.
example.zh: 乘客可以在最上層甲板欣賞風景。

similar.diff: pier 指伸入水中的突堤式碼頭；dock 泛指船停靠和裝卸貨的地方。

example.en: The ferry leaves from the pier near the market.
example.zh: 渡輪從市場附近的碼頭出發。

similar.diff: port 是整個港口或港口城市；dock 是港口裡船停靠的某個位置。

example.en: The cargo ship arrived at the port on Monday.
example.zh: 貨輪在週一抵達港口。

example.en: Many small boats stay in the harbor during storms.
example.zh: 暴風雨期間，許多小船都停在港灣裡。

example.en: The port handles thousands of boxes every day.
example.zh: 這個港口每天處理數千個貨箱。

example.en: The cargo will arrive at the dock on Friday.
example.zh: 這批貨物週五會抵達碼頭。

example.en: The goods are stored in a warehouse near the port.
example.zh: 貨物存放在港口附近的倉庫。

example.en: Boxes were stacked on the dock waiting for the truck.
example.zh: 箱子堆在月台上，等著卡車來載。

example.en: The delivery boat docks here at eight every morning.
example.zh: 送貨船每天早上八點在這裡靠岸。

senses.en: a place by the water where ships stop and load goods

example.en: The new dock can hold three large ships at once.
example.zh: 新碼頭可以同時容納三艘大型船隻。

senses.en: a platform at a building where trucks load and unload goods
senses.distinguish: 出現 truck、warehouse、loading 時，指的是倉庫的月台。

example.en: Deliveries should be left at the dock behind the warehouse.
example.zh: 貨品請放在倉庫後面的月台。

senses.en: to come to a dock and stop there

example.en: The cruise ship docks in Keelung for one full day.
example.zh: 這艘郵輪在基隆停靠整整一天。

senses.en: to take some money away from someone's pay
senses.distinguish: 後面接 pay、wages 或金額時，指扣錢。

example.en: Managers can dock wages when staff leave work early.
example.zh: 員工提早下班時，主管可以扣工資。
